Customers.description: Customer accounts, one row per company.

columns.Region: Sales region the customer is assigned to: West, East, North, South, or Central.
columns.Industry: Customer's industry vertical, e.g. Retail, Technology, Healthcare.
columns.SignupDate: Date the customer account was created.

columns.Status: Order lifecycle state: Paid, Overdue, Pending, Cancelled, or Refunded.
columns.TotalAmount: Total monetary value of the order in USD.

columns.Category: Product category, e.g. Electronics, Furniture, Software Licenses.
columns.UnitPrice: List price per unit in USD.

Inventory.description: Stock levels per product per warehouse.

columns.QuantityOnHand: Current units in stock at this warehouse.
columns.ReorderThreshold: Stock level below which the product should be reordered.

OrderItems.description: Line items belonging to an order, one row per product within an order.

columns.Quantity: Number of units of this product in the order.
columns.UnitPrice: Price per unit at time of order (may differ from current Products.UnitPrice).
